details:
Q1: What specifically should be improved?
Choices:
A. A named file, function, or workflow (RECOMMENDED)
B. The issue-to-PR pipeline
C. Documentation or onboarding
D. Tests or CI
Q2: What observable result should define “better”?
Choices:
A. Fix a reproducible defect; provide current and expected behavior (RECOMMENDED)
B. Improve reliability or performance; provide the target metric
C. Improve usability or clarity; describe the intended user experience
